name: Name tag: arrow
when: A character is named while on screen. A thin arrow points at the head from the plate; the plate needs about 650 px of room on that side of the head (right or left), or room under the chin (below).
anchor: The scene starts on the character's name: the arrow shoots in from frame 3, its head bites on frame 8, the name types out from frame 11 (the plate's frames).

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.name: the character's name as the voice says it (shown in capitals), 20 characters at most
vars.role: one short line about them, 40 characters at most; empty = the plate stays one row, name only
vars.headX: the head point, x in px on the 1920x1080 frame: the outer edge of the head (hair or ear) at eye level, on the side the plate goes; with side = below, the bottom of the chin. Read it off a snapshot of the shot; 60 px off still reads right
vars.headY: the head point, y in px
vars.side: right or left: the plate beside the head, the arrow horizontal at the point's height, its tip 20 px off the point; below: the arrow points up at the chin and the plate runs outward from under it
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later)

changed: nametag-A with its face box replaced by a 110 px arrow (5 px stroke, the brackets' weight) whose tip stops 20 px off one head point. The arrow's head bites in with the brackets' lock-on motion; the plate's frames are nametag-A's. The role line is full white at weight 500 (was 74 % white). The exit pulls the arrow back into the plate in 7 frames.
